content:
kevin: Quick liveness check for BlackHawk private rollout — can everyone confirm owner/ETA for egress rules, airgap bundle staging, and cert rotation?
anya: I can take firewall/egress. Need final list of trust targets (S3 endpoint + metrics).
devon: Networking note — customer said they will allow outbound to our S3 hostname but not IPs. We need to provide DNS name + signed presigned workflow.
kevin: Good call. @anya, we'll need a short script and the exact DNS names. can we also include a fallback NAT plan?
anya: Yep. Proposed egress list: 
```
*.redwood-inference.s3.amazonaws.com
metrics.redwood-inference.net:443
registry.redwood-inference.internal (for airgap pull)
```
I'll add a small curl-based probe they can run.
salma: Staging of the airgap bundle is blocked on image signing key rotation — I hit a failure in our signing job yesterday (CI-4321). I can rotate but need a 30m maintenance window.
carl: Product asks for canary on Monday 09:00-11:00 PT. If signing happens after that window we risk missing the milestone. Any workarounds?
devon: Workaround: We can serve unsigned bundle to an isolated test cluster behind ACLs while sig rotation completes. Not ideal but buys time. Requires ops approval.
kevin: ops approval = @ops-bot, tagging for scheduled maintenance note. Also need a named owner for the isolated cluster plan.
ops-bot: automated: Maintenance window request received from salma for CI-4321. Please reply with :thumbsup: to approve or :no_entry: to deny. (scheduled until 4312347200)
kevin: :thumbsup: from me. salma, you have the window. Please post exact start/stop in this thread.
salma: Plan: rotate key at 07:30 PT, smoke sign images by 08:00, push staged airgap bundle to customer share by 08:30. Will post logs to https://internal.redwood/ci/4321 after run.
carl: Noted. canary still OK if smoke passes by 08:30. I keep Monday 09:00 as target.
anya: For customer egress they need the following checklist to open:
- allow outbound DNS (tcp/53) to our DNS resolver
- allow TLS outbound to metrics.redwood-inference.net:443
- allow HTTPS to S3 hostname used for bundles
I'll post the one-line probe:
```bash
# verify access to metrics + bundle host
curl -sSf --max-time 5 https://metrics.redwood-inference.net/health || echo 'metrics blocked'
curl -sSf --max-time 5 https://registry.redwood-inference.s3.amazonaws.com/ping || echo 's3 blocked'
```
kevin: Also need to confirm TLS cert rotation plan for on-prem gateway — cert validity expires 2026-04-02. Who owns rotation?
carl: assign to salma for rotation ops, with devon networking to update gateway config.
salma: ACK — will rotate during the key rotation window and update gateway.
devon: I'll prep a small playbook to update gateway config and verify with a health check: `HTTP 200 on /_rdw/health` after reload.
kevin: PR pings: 
- Firewall changes: https://git.redwood/infra/fw/pulls/498 (needs anya review)
- Airgap bundle tooling: https://git.redwood/devops/airgap/pulls/212 (salma review)
Please ping reviewers on PRs if you need green checks.
anya: Reviewing fw PR today, will add comments by 15:00 PT.
salma: Reviewing airgap PR now. If any blockers I'll flag here.
carl: Customer readiness check: engineering wants signed confirmation from BlackHawk that egress rules were applied by end of day Friday. Can someone own outreach?
kevin: I'll message customer success to confirm. tagging @ops-bot to create a follow-up reminder for Fri EOD.
ops-bot: automated: Reminder created — BlackHawk egress confirmation due 4312411200.
kevin: Summary/owners: 
- Firewall/egress: anya (script + checklist)
- Image signing + airgap staging: salma (maintenance window)
- Networking/gateway config: devon (playbook + healthcheck)
- Customer comms: kevin (CS ping)
- Canary coordination: carl (09:00-11:00 PT Monday)
If no blockers by EOD tomorrow we proceed with the sign/airgap path.
devon: One more thing — if customer refuses DNS-based allowlist, we need to provide an egress NAT IP bundle. I'll compile expected IP hints by EOD.
anya: thanks — will include both DNS and IP options in the script.
kevin: Perfect. I'll follow up with a short checklist doc and link it here when ready. Thanks all. (reacted with :rocket:)
